item.title: The Future of Education Summit 2025: Work Integrated Learning & Career Hubs
item.description: In Africa — and globally— there is growing recognition that universities must not only teach knowledge but also facilitate pathways to employment. Work Integrated Learning (WIL) and Career Hubs are proving essential tools in this transformation. This panel explores how universities and corporations can form meaningful, mutually beneficial partnerships that equip students with real-world experience while meeting industry needs.
